title: Two-Penny Hangover and Coffin Beds
hook: Homeless Londoners paid two pennies to sleep leaning against a rope.

scenes.text: In Victorian London's East End, thousands of destitute laborers could never afford a sixpence bed in a boarding house.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grim foggy brick alleyway in Victorian London with smoking brick chimneys and gas streetlights casting long shadows. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In Victorian London's East End, thousands of destitute laborers could never afford a sixpence bed in a boarding house.

scenes.text: Instead, commercial doss houses offered brutal tiered sleeping options starting at just one single copper penny.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grubby wooden ticket booth in a dimly lit Victorian lodging cellar with chalk prices on a slate board. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Instead, commercial doss houses offered brutal tiered sleeping options starting at just one single copper penny.

scenes.text: For one penny, you got the 'Penny Sit Up': permission to sit on a bare wooden bench inside out of the rain, but you were beaten if you fell asleep.
scenes.imagePrompt: Long bare wooden bench against damp peeling brick cellar wall with dim gas jet lamp hissing overhead. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: For one penny, you got the 'Penny Sit Up': permission to sit on a bare wooden bench inside out of the rain, but you were beaten if you fell asleep.

scenes.text: For two pennies, you got the 'Two-Penny Hangover': sitting on a bench with a thick clothesline rope tied taut across your chest to lean on.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy hemp clothesline rope strung taut across rows of wooden benches in a crowded boarding shed. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: For two pennies, you got the 'Two-Penny Hangover': sitting on a bench with a thick clothesline rope tied taut across your chest to lean on.

scenes.text: At 6 AM sharp, the landlord cut or untied the rope with a knife, abruptly dropping dozens of exhausted sleepers straight to the floor.

scenes.voicedText: At 6 AM sharp, the landlord cut or untied the rope with a knife, abruptly dropping dozens of exhausted sleepers straight to the floor.

scenes.text: For four pence, Salvation Army shelters offered 'coffin beds': wooden boxes with tarpaulin covers. Could you have survived a night there?
